rationale_summary: The annual QLC-enterprise-SSD Outcome remains unresolved, so the next value is independent corroboration of deployment/platform integration. The recovered sources differ materially in vintage and specificity: a 2024 VAST configuration names capacity but not vendor/QLC, later VAST documentation names P5336 QLC explicitly, later NVIDIA documentation names Micron NVMe on GB200 but not the 9550 model or 2024 qualification vintage, and DUG directly describes QLC in its own deployed VAST architecture. Existing source/Evidence/search-depth owners can represent these distinctions without a new semantic owner. This step remains Evidence-only until a truthful existing Reality predicate is identified.
